input.command:
$os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem
"Total: {0:N1} GB   Used: {1:N1} GB   Free: {2:N1} GB" -f ($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1MB), (($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize-$os.FreePhysicalMemory)/1MB), ($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB)
""
Get-Process | Group-Object ProcessName | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ App = $_.Name; Count = $_.Count; 'RAM (MB)' = [int](($_.Group | Measure-Object WorkingSet64 -Sum).Sum/1MB) } } | Sort-Object 'RAM (MB)' -Descending | Select-Object -First 20 | Format-Table -AutoSize
input.description: Show RAM usage grouped by app
